subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What different aspects of their purchase are Amazon reviewers actually talking about?

judge.implied_focus: The purchase aspect(s) an Amazon review discusses (aspect-based decomposition of review content)

per_column.name: aspect_product_quality
per_column.rationale: Binary flag for whether the review touches on product quality -- a coherent aspect facet.

per_column.name: aspect_price_value
per_column.rationale: Flag for price/value aspect, a distinct facet of the purchase.

per_column.name: aspect_shipping_delivery
per_column.rationale: Flag for shipping/delivery, a clear purchase aspect.

per_column.name: aspect_customer_service
per_column.rationale: Flag for customer service aspect, coherent with the focus.

per_column.name: aspect_features_functionality
per_column.rationale: Flag for features/functionality, a meaningful product aspect.

per_column.name: aspect_ease_of_use
per_column.rationale: Flag for usability aspect, distinct and relevant.

per_column.name: aspect_aesthetics_design
per_column.rationale: Flag for design/aesthetics aspect, coherent facet.

per_column.name: aspect_content_narrative
per_column.rationale: Flag for content/narrative aspect (relevant for media items); a defensible aspect facet.

per_column.name: primary_aspect
per_column.rationale: Categorical roll-up identifying the dominant aspect, giving a single-label view over the multi-flag structure.

judge.rationale: Every added column centres tightly on a single, data-inferable focus: which aspects of the purchase reviewers discuss. This directly answers the query's 'what different aspects are reviewers talking about'. The structure is sound: a set of mutually-distinguishable binary aspect indicators at a useful granularity, plus a categorical primary_aspect roll-up that summarises dominance -- neither a bare restatement nor undifferentiated noise. The aspects are semantically distinct facets (quality, price, shipping, service, features, usability, design, content), avoiding the generic-metric trap (no token counts or bare sentiment). The implied focus is highly actionable: an analyst can quantify aspect prevalence, cross with label_pos to study which aspects drive positive/negative sentiment, and prioritise operational areas. Minor deduction only because empty descriptions/domains leave the exact coding conventions implicit, but the semantics are clear.
